howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From your vision to your doorstep in three simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Use our interactive 3D configurator to choose your felt color, wood finish, leg style, and accessories. Upload your own logo if you want.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We review your order and reach out within 24 hours via WhatsApp or email to confirm details and provide your final quote.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Our craftsmen handcraft your table to exact specifications. Once ready, we deliver directly to your door.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you order.
faq.q1: What materials is the table made from?
faq.a1: We use solid wood (oak, walnut, or mahogany) for the frame and legs, and high-quality billiard felt for the playing surface. All materials are selected for durability and aesthetics.
faq.q2: How long does it take to build?
faq.a2: Each table takes approximately 7–14 business days to complete, depending on the customization options selected.
faq.q3: Do you deliver anywhere in the country?
faq.a3: Yes! We deliver nationwide. Shipping costs and times vary by location — we'll confirm these when we contact you after your order.
faq.q4: Can I add my own logo or design to the surface?
faq.a4: Absolutely. You can upload any image (PNG, JPG, or SVG with transparent background) directly in the 3D configurator, and it will be printed or applied to the felt surface.
faq.q5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a5: We accept bank transfers, cash on delivery, and major credit/debit cards. Full payment or a 50% deposit is required to begin production.
faq.q6: Do the tables come with a warranty?
faq.a6: Yes — all tables come with a 1-year warranty covering manufacturing defects in the frame and materials.
